caption: The drawing depicts a historical men’s outfit consisting of a three-piece ensemble. The visible objects are a long, light blue frock coat with buttons down the right side, a matching light blue waistcoat underneath, and a tan or beige pair of breeches emerging from beneath the coat. The coat has decorative cuffs with buttons and a pocket flap on the right, and the vest is buttoned up, revealing a white or cream ruffled shirt or cravat at the neckline. The fabric of the breeches appears loose and draped, contrasting with the more fitted blue coat and vest. In the upper right corner of the drawing, a smaller line sketch shows the back view of the coat, indicating its design and length. The background of the image is plain, off-white paper, and there are no other objects present in the scene. The artist's name and credits are written in the bottom right corner.
title: Man's Coat & Waistcoat
